name: Exp_ElderImpulseSystem
summary: This EA implements Alexander Elder's Impulse System, which combines a 13-period EMA with MACD histogram direction to determine trend impulse. It opens buy positions when both EMA and MACD histogram are bullish, opens sell positions when both are bearish, and closes positions when the impulse reverses. The system uses the custom ElderImpulseSystem indicator buffers to read color-coded signal values for entry and exit decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了亚历山大·埃尔德的冲动系统，结合13周期EMA和MACD柱状图方向来判断趋势冲动。当EMA和MACD柱状图同时看涨时开多仓，同时看跌时开空仓，冲动反转时平仓。系统通过自定义ElderImpulseSystem指标的缓冲区读取颜色编码的信号值来做出入场和出场决策。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于亚历山大·埃尔德的冲动系统策略，核心概念是同时使用趋势指标（EMA）和动量指标（MACD柱状图）来确认趋势冲动。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区值为2（看涨冲动）且前一值为1或0时开多仓；当值为1（看跌冲动）且前一值为0或2时开空仓。出场条件为：当冲动信号反转时平仓——看涨冲动出现时平空仓，看跌冲动出现时平多仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或保证金比例模式（MM参数），支持LOT和FREEMARGIN两种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制，默认0.1表示10%的可用保证金用于开仓。止损和止盈分别默认设为1000点和2000点，风险回报比为1:2。系统仅在信号柱发生变化或新K线出现时重新计算信号，避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements Alexander Elder's Impulse System strategy, whose core concept combines a trend indicator (EMA) with a momentum indicator (MACD histogram) to confirm trend impulses. Entry conditions: when the indicator buffer value is 2 (bullish impulse) and the previous value is 1 or 0, a buy position opens; when the value is 1 (bearish impulse) and the previous value is 0 or 2, a sell position opens. Exit conditions: positions close when the impulse signal reverses — sell positions close on bullish impulse, buy positions close on bearish impulse. Position sizing uses either fixed lot or margin percentage mode (MM parameter), supporting LOT and FREEMARGIN modes. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter, defaulting to 0.1 meaning 10% of available margin is used for opening positions. Stop loss and take profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The system only recalculates signals when the signal bar changes or a new bar appears, preventing redundant trades.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易使用的保证金比例
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling position size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式：LOT（固定手数）或FREEMARGIN（按保证金比例）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode: fixed lots or margin percentage

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于计算交易信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Bar index for trade signal calculation

pros: 双指标确认机制（EMA+MACD）减少了假信号，提高了入场质量
具备完整的止损止盈设置，默认风险回报比为1:2，风险控制合理
支持独立开关买入/卖出的开仓和平仓，灵活性高
使用IsNewBar机制限制信号计算频率，避免同一K线内重复交易
策略基于经典技术分析理论（埃尔德冲动系统），逻辑清晰可验证
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation (EMA + MACD) reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Complete stop loss and take profit setup with default 1:2 risk-reward ratio provides sound risk control
Independent toggles for buy/sell open and close operations offer high flexibility
IsNewBar mechanism limits signal calculation frequency, preventing redundant trades within the same bar
Strategy based on classic technical analysis theory (Elder's Impulse System) with clear and verifiable logic
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标ElderImpulseSystem，若该指标未安装则EA无法运行
止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR动态计算，在不同波动率市场下适应性差
缺少加仓和减仓逻辑，无法在趋势发展中进行金字塔式加仓
未考虑点差和交易成本对短线交易的影响
信号仅在K线完成时计算，在剧烈行情中可能错过及时入场机会
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator ElderImpulseSystem; EA fails to run if the indicator is not installed
Stop loss and take profit use fixed points instead of ATR-based dynamic calculation, adapting poorly across varying volatility markets
Lacks scaling in/out logic, unable to pyramid positions as the trend develops
Does not account for spread and transaction costs impact on short-term trades
Signals only calculated on bar completion, potentially missing timely entry opportunities during sharp market moves
improvements: 将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，以适应不同市场波动率
增加点差过滤机制，在点差过大时暂停交易以避免不利成交
添加持仓检查和重复开仓保护，避免同一信号多次开仓
improvements_en: Change stop loss and take profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different market volatilities
Add spread filter mechanism to pause trading when spread is excessively wide, avoiding unfavorable fills
Add position check and duplicate open protection to prevent multiple openings on the same signal

risk_points: 依赖外部指标文件，缺少指标时EA初始化失败但不会造成资金损失
固定点数止损在极端行情下可能不够灵活，但已设有止损保护
risk_points_en: Depends on external indicator file; EA initialization fails when indicator is missing but no capital loss occurs
Fixed-point stop loss may be inflexible during extreme market conditions, though stop loss protection is in place
